The presence of a thick enhancing margin and multiple satellites further supports an aggressive, IDH-wildtype phenotype. Given that extensive necrosis is a more robust indicator of aggressive biology than the T2-FLAIR mismatch sign (which can be subject to calculation variability), the prediction leans towards IDH-wildtype, but with low confidence due to the strong contradictory evidence.
